question:
The following bar graph shows the sales of tractors by a showroom in different months. What was the approximate percentage decline from August to September ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31574a6b92be9fd4ca83a070d675243c9053041a812830b21d663782b3636933.png]
solution:
**Calculation:**

Approximate percentage decline from August to September = (3475 - 1875)/3475 × 100

⇒ 46%

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
